verdict.rationale: The docs show founders can request a new 409A valuation in-platform via Equity > Valuations > Add > Request New Valuation, so in-platform ordering is supported. Nothing shows the valuation is generated from live cap table data, is audit-ready, or refreshes on a schedule. Confidence is lowered because the update FAQ describes helping customers move to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley). Missing for 10: evidence the valuation draws on live cap table data, audit-ready/defensibility assurances, scheduled or automatic refreshes, independent corroboration.
